name: What can go wrong if permit and inspection coordination is handled poorly?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if permit and inspection coordination is handled poorly?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are starting work before the permit is issued, missing a required inspection, or submitting incomplete documents that trigger review delays. Denver’s system makes it clear that inspections must be tied to an issued permit, so coordination mistakes can push a project off schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common problems include delayed approvals, failed inspections, and extra rework if work begins too early. Missing paperwork or skipped inspections can also hold up the project.
